description: Build the steps that repay debt. 'auto' requires slippage; 'manual' repays from the owner's wallet. Returns UNSIGNED transaction steps for the owner to sign in order; this server never holds keys or sends transactions. The build expires after 180 seconds (`expiresAt`, unix ms): build immediately before signing, not as a plan for later. Builds are single-use: rebuilding an open predicts a different position address, so never replay one. A successful build does not guarantee a successful transaction: pass `steps` to `simulate` and check `ok` before asking anyone to sign. Any build the owner funds (open, adjust push, manual repay), zap-in or not, gets 422 `insufficient_balance` (`token`, `required`, `available`) when the owner holds less than it pulls.

forceSwapper.description: 'auto' only. Retry only: route the swap through the swapper instead of the routing engine. Set it when simulate reports a build as failing, then rebuild.

owner.description: EOA that owns the position and signs the steps. The smart account is derived from it server-side.

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal: 0.005 means 0.5% (not 1e18 fixed-point)
